key_takeaways: 단 67센트의 비용과 1.5시간의 학습 시간으로 구현된 고효율 소형 Transformer
ARC-AGI-1 벤치마크에서 여러 대형 언어 모델(LLM)을 뛰어넘는 추론 성능 입증
대규모 가중치 중심의 학습 패러다임에 대한 새로운 대안과 효율성 시사

en.title: A Small Transformer Trained for $0.67 in 1.5 Hours Outperforms Large LLMs on ARC-AGI-1
en.hook: Discover how an ultra-low-cost, efficiently trained small model beats major large language models on the complex ARC-AGI-1 reasoning benchmark.
key_takeaways: Highly efficient small Transformer trained with just $0.67 and 1.5 hours
Demonstrates reasoning performance surpassing multiple large LLMs on ARC-AGI-1
Offers a compelling alternative and efficiency perspective to massive scale-focused paradigms

zh.title: 仅花 0.67 美元训练 1.5 小时的微型 Transformer 在 ARC-AGI-1 上超越大模型
zh.hook: 探索以极低成本和时间训练的小型模型如何在复杂的 ARC-AGI-1 推理基准测试中击败多款大型语言模型。
key_takeaways: 仅耗资 0.67 美元、训练 1.5 小时的高效小型 Transformer
在 ARC-AGI-1 基准测试中展现出超越多个大语言模型的推理性能
为过度依赖巨量参数的训练范式提供了富有吸引力的新替代方案与效率启示
